description: Manage TV series in Sonarr: add a series with its quality and folder, search for missing episodes, read this week's calendar, the download queue and history, and check health and disk space. Start a workflow when an episode is downloaded or grabbed, a series is added, or Sonarr raises a health warning.

sonarr_episode_downloaded_trigger.description: Runs when Sonarr imports a downloaded episode into the library: once per episode, so a whole season imported at once runs once for each. Episodes imported before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only episodes of this series: its title or ID in Sonarr. Leave blank for every series.
parameters.name: series

sonarr_episode_grabbed_trigger.description: Runs when Sonarr finds a release of an episode and sends it to the download client, before it has downloaded. Grabs from before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only grabs of this series: its title or ID in Sonarr. Leave blank for every series.
parameters.name: series

sonarr_health_issue_trigger.description: Runs when Sonarr starts reporting a health warning or error, such as an indexer or download client it can't reach or a folder it can't see. Issues already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it; one that clears and comes back starts it again.

parameters.description: Warnings and errors, or errors only (type error). Leave blank for warnings and errors.
parameters.name: level

sonarr_series_added_trigger.description: Runs when a series is added to Sonarr, from its screens, an import list, another app or a workflow. Series already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only series added with this tag, such as requests. Leave blank for every series.
parameters.name: tag
